name: Crucible ThermoSleeve Chrome Liner — Pair
description: Neoprene-analog sleeves lined with graphene heating filaments, designed to wrap chrome arm augmentations and prevent dangerous thermal transfer in sub-zero conditions. Sold in pairs, they cinch with magnetic closures directly over exposed chrome without requiring skin contact. Available in matte black or safety orange.
functionality: Maintains chrome augmentation temperature above dangerous cold thresholds; USB-C charge port on left sleeve powers heating element for up to 10 hours.
what_it_says: This person has chrome and knows how to keep it from killing them — practical, no-nonsense aug maintenance.
story_hooks: The heating element on one sleeve runs hot — dangerously hot — and someone has scratched a warning glyph into the cinch in Yoruba script.
A Circuit worker's chrome sleeve liner is the only thing keeping frostbite from setting into the nerve interface points at the wrist.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Cryogenic Projector CP-4 'Frostbite'

physical_description.visual_profile: Form-fitting tubular sleeves that cling to the forearm and upper arm, creating a sleek geometric silhouette when worn over chrome augmentations. The matte finish absorbs light, making augmented limbs appear less reflective and more integrated with the body. Safety orange variants glow subtly under neon environments.
physical_description.fit: Compression fit — snug against the arm without restricting movement, designed to conform to the contours of cylindrical chrome cyberlimbs. Stretches slightly for donning/doffing but maintains contact pressure for thermal efficiency.
physical_description.primary_material: Neoprene analog (synthetic thermal polymer) with embedded graphene heating filament matrix. Outer shell is matte-finish ballistic-grade synth-rubber.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly tacky outer surface with fine ribbed interior facing. Subtle texture variation where heating filaments run parallel to the sleeve length. Edges reinforced with overlocked seams.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black (primary — preferred by corpo users) or safety orange (high-visibility, favored in industrial/hazard zones). Both finishes have minimal branding — small embossed Crucible logo at wrist cuff.
physical_description.closures: Dual magnetic snap closures positioned along the inner forearm seam, allowing one-handed application over chrome without removal of augmentation. Closures are recessed to prevent snagging.
distinctive_features: Embedded graphene heating filaments visible as thin parallel lines running down the sleeve
Seamless wrist opening with elasticated cuff for secure fit
Inner thermal-conductive coating reflects body heat back to augmentation
Magnetic closure system compatible with ferrous chrome alloys
Slight wear pattern at magnetic closure points from repeated fastening
No external pockets — purely functional thermal wear
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 functional equipment. Expensive enough to signal augmentation ownership and safety consciousness (Tier 2 corporate chrome workers), but practical and mass-produced enough for Tier 3 street workers who maintain their own augmentations.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented workers in cold-climate zones, industrial districts, and corporate chrome maintenance crews. Signals someone who invests in gear longevity and thermal safety — not flashy, but competent. Common in the Detroit Sector and northern GLMZ territories.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but maintained — minor discoloration at magnetic closure points from repeated use. Graphene filaments may show slight fading after 12-18 months of daily use. Generally kept clean, as functionality depends on material integrity.
